currentParagraphText: “It is. It shall take us many years to recover from the damage you have done. But we will recover. We always do. I come here today, facing you with the Ancestors at my back, carrying the will of my tribe on my shoulders. Say, hunter, what do you have besides the ability to hide like a coward?” the Warlord said, proving himself quite a talker.
